decisions.reason: As a newly launched automation add-on close to the firm’s core offer, it fits the strategic push toward smarter automation and its market potential is still uncertain enough that the option value likely exceeds the short-term carrying cost.

This product also builds directly on the established machinery business, so in an expanding firm and growing industry management would usually keep it on the market while customer adoption information is still emerging.

Although more distant from the established offer and therefore costlier and riskier to carry, the recent launch, dedicated presentation, and positive external signal from the design award suggest uncertainty has not resolved enough yet to justify abandoning the option.
